label: TP
reason: User input is partially escaped (double quotes replaced with ") but remains unescaped for single quotes and other HTML-special characters. Since the HTML attribute uses single quotes, injected single quotes in user input would break out of the attribute and enable XSS payloads like "';alert('xss')".

evidence.note: Unsanitized user input used in HTML attribute with partial escaping (only double quotes)
